name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – Article 5, after § 1 – Am 121
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1a. During the preliminary assessment and, where necessary, the environmental assessment of a modification or extension of a lawfully authorised project within the meaning of Article 1(2), point (a), of Directive 2011/92/EU, the competent authority shall assess the likely significant effects of the proposed modification or extension, including its cumulative effects, in conjunction with the existing project and other relevant projects. The authority shall use the results of previous assessments to the extent that they remain current and relevant. A new assessment of unaffected parts of the existing project may be required solely on the basis of the proposed modification or extension only to the extent that this is necessary to assess cumulative effects or is required under Union law.
